name: Chu x Pet
source:
The protagonist is a high school student whose life changes drastically when one day his mother tells him a man has proposed to her and she asks for his blessing. Being raised entirely by his mother he accepts so she can be happy.
Then the day he finally meets his new family he shockingly finds out his new sister is the school's student council president and popular student Sakuya, as he now forms part of the Aotsuki family.
Sakuya has an unnatural fixation on making him her "brother pet". His cousin Shuri feels threatened by Sakuya taking the protagonist's sister spot and his childhood friend Kotori hates him for some reason.
Eventually he is forced to run as the next student council president. Sakuya, Shuri, Kotori and Sakuya's twin sisters Yuzu and Kana will help him in his campaign.
Who will the protagonist choose to help him in the election?
translation:
主角是一名高中生。一天，母亲告诉他有人向自己求婚，并请求他的祝福，他的人生就此彻底改变。由于从小由母亲独自抚养，他为了母亲的幸福答应了。
终于见到新家人的那天，他震惊地发现新妹妹竟是学校的学生会长、校园人气王咲夜，而自己也成了青月家的一员。
咲夜异常执着于把他变成自己的“哥哥宠物”。他的表妹朱莉觉得咲夜抢走了妹妹的位置，青梅竹马小鸟则不知为何讨厌他。
后来，他被迫竞选下一任学生会长。咲夜、朱莉、小鸟，以及咲夜的双胞胎妹妹柚子和加奈都会帮助他参加竞选。
主角会选择谁来协助自己赢得选举？
